meta.disclaimer_ar: كل القيم ديناميكية وتتغير. الجداول مؤرخة ومرتبطة بمصادر رسمية. تحقق من المصدر قبل الاعتماد. لا ضمانات لأوقات المعالجة أو الأسعار.
meta.disclaimer_en: All values are dynamic and dated. Verify against the official source before relying on them. Processing times are not guarantees.

applies_to: Rural or francophone community immigration pilots

exempt: dependent children of principal applicant or sponsor
protected persons and eligible H&C applicants

proof_of_funds_express_entry.live_reverification: live page re-opened 2026-11-22; the table shown is still the one marked Updated July 7, 2025 (2 members = 19001 CAD); no newer 2026 table exists as of this date
not_required_for: applicants authorized to work in Canada with a valid job offer (even under FSW/FST)
rules: family size includes applicant, spouse/partner, dependent children of both, even if Canadian citizens/PRs or not accompanying
official bank letters required: balances, 6-month average, account numbers, debts
funds must be legally accessible at application and at visa issuance; no real-estate equity; no borrowed money

study_permit_financial_support.note: living expenses only, excludes tuition and transportation; updated annually; Quebec follows MIFI/CAQ requirements

exemptions: existing permanent residents (except specific PR card renewal case)
applicants 80 or over at submission (no age exemption for asylum claimants)
valid US visa holders transiting Canada
TR applicants who gave biometrics for a PR application still in process

reuse.permanent_residence: must give biometrics with every new PR application

saudi_arabia.note: confirm all cities and hours on VFS page before visiting

yemen.note: no VAC listed in the official directory as of 2026-11-22; applicants use a VAC in another country per the official finder

facts.express_entry: upfront exam after ITA, before applying; results must be valid at submission and at landing; requirement reinstated effective 2025-08-21 for EE applications submitted on or after that date, reversing the 2023-10-01 policy (date sourced from legal-firm summaries of the IRCC announcement, e.g. Fragomen 2025-08-12; the rule itself confirmed on the live official page 2026-11-22)
facts.temporary_residence: generally no IME unless specified situations (public-health jobs, long stays from designated countries); see requirements-temporary-residents page
facts.in_canada_exemption: temporary public policy exempting certain in-Canada foreign nationals extended to 2029-10-05; applicants with an IME within 5 years include the IME number
facts.cost: paid by applicant at appointment; varies by physician and country; not refunded on refusal; refugees/asylum seekers may be exempt

saudi_arabia.process: IRCC sends a request then a facilitation letter via the IRCC Riyadh web form; apply in person at Criminal Evidence Division or via the Amen portal with an active Absher account; MOI recommends the in-person route for international use (MOFA attestation only for in-person certificates)
saudi_arabia.non_residents: certificates only available to non-citizens with current legal residence; those on final exit may be unable to obtain one; exact official sentence to state if asked: 'I cannot provide a police certificate for the time I spent in Saudi Arabia because certificates are only available to people who have current legal residence status.'

yemen.process: citizens apply in person at the Office of the Deputy General Director, or via a representative with power of attorney if abroad; non-citizens resident 6+ months apply in person with the Canadian embassy request letter and valid residence

translation.rule: documents not in English or French must be uploaded with an English or French translation plus a scan of the original (or certified photocopy if the translation was based on one); all non-EN/FR stamps and seals must also be translated
translation.affidavit: conditional: no affidavit needed when the translation is stamped by a certified translator (an explanatory letter may be included); an affidavit sworn before an authorized commissioner is required only when a translation cannot be completed by a certified translator, and must reference both the translation and the source document
restrictions: family members, representatives and consultants of the applicant may not translate documents, even if lawyers, notaries or translators
a translator still in the process of certification does not count as a certified translator for IRCC

language_tests.scope_note: Express Entry programs require a test; work permit applications themselves have no IRCC language test; study permits follow the institution's requirements. No universal language test for all permits.

example_cost_third_party.source: ksaexpatguide.com reading of British Council and IDP Saudi pages

needed_for: CRS points for foreign education (applicant and accompanying spouse)
not_needed_for: work permits and study permits in general

processing_times.methodology: backward-looking (80% of past cases) or forward-looking (inventory, capacity, levels plan); starts at complete application receipt, ends at decision; not a maximum or a guarantee

reproducibility.country_based_tr_values: https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/documents/json/data-ptime-en.json (last updated stamped 2026-11-18); tool selections: Temporary residence, then application type, then country Saudi Arabia (code SA) or Yemen (code YE); 'no time available' means the tool shows no value for that country
reproducibility.forward_looking_pr_values: https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/documents/json/flpt-en.json (last updated stamped 2026-11-17); tool selections by program name
reproducibility.fallback: if the data files are unreachable or differ, the interactive tool with the same selections is the reference; treat any other value as unverified

employer_must_pay_not_worker.lmia_fee_refund: not refunded on withdrawal or negative LMIA; cannot be paid by or recovered from the worker
lmia_fee_exemptions: in-home caregivers for medical needs with certificate
childcare in home, family gross income 150000 or less
employer_must_pay_not_worker.recruitment_and_rep_fees: cannot be charged to or recovered from the worker
employer_must_pay_not_worker.low_wage_stream_transport: employer pays round-trip transportation, not recoverable
employer_must_pay_not_worker.low_wage_stream_housing: suitable affordable housing under 30% of before-tax income (CMHC definitions)
employer_must_pay_not_worker.low_wage_stream_health_insurance: employer covers until public coverage applies

worker_typically_still_pays: biometrics 85 CAD unless exempt or valid within 10 years
biometrics travel if no local VAC
employer_funded_branch.concept_note: IRCC fee liability does not require personal payment by the applicant; an employer or sponsor may pay government fees. The reverse is prohibited for LMIA and recruitment fees: those may never be charged to the worker.

rents_cmhc_fall_2025_survey_october_2025.benchmark_warning: survey benchmarks, not live listings; turnover rents exceed sitting-tenant averages

mbm.description: Canada's official poverty line, 2023 base, reference family of 4

british_columbia.waiting_period: remainder of residency month plus 2 months

rules: proof of funds is a display requirement, not an expense
fx rate must be fetched at calculation time, never hardcoded
language test and ECA are pathway conditional, not universal
